column1: # Hand written 1.6.4 -> 1.7.10 member forwards (tab separated; owners, names and descriptors in legacy form, the 1.7.10 names for classes 1.7.10 renamed).
# Wins over member-renames.tsv and member-heuristic.tsv (generated by tools/gen_forward_164.py). Read by ForwardMembers; the unit test
# Forward164MembersTest checks every target against legacy/1.7.10/{methods,fields}.txt. The owner of an M/F/R/G line is the 1.6.4
# declaring class; a call through any subtype matches. Int-id members (blockID, getBlockId, setBlock, blocksList, itemID) belong to the id facade, not here.
# M owner name desc newName                       rename a method (the loader's remapper renames declaration and calls)
# F owner name newName                            rename a field
# R owner name desc call newOwner newName newDesc retarget a call, same stack (newOwner "=" keeps the call's owner)
# R owner name desc static helperOwner helper helperDesc   call a static helper (receiver first) in the 1.6.4 shim
# R owner name desc wrap-text newName newDesc     wrap the last (String) argument into a ChatComponentText
# R owner name desc chain o1 n1 d1 o2 n2 d2       call o1.n1 on the receiver, then o2.n2 on its result
# G owner field desc getterOwner getter getterDesc  read of a field becomes a call (getterOwner "=" keeps the owner)
# G owner field desc field newField newDesc [owner name desc]  read of a field retyped, optionally followed by a call on the value
# C owner desc newDesc drop                       constructor lost its leading (name) argument
# Entity names: players, mobs and minecarts all have getCommandSenderName in 1.7.10
# World: tile entities are addressed the way 1.7.10 names them; materials and opacity come from the block
# NBT: 1.7.10 tags carry no name, lists are typed
# Missing-shim pass (links that were synthesized empty before): renamed enum constant and fields, sound manager, NBT names, server lists
